name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Версия релиза (например 1.0.1)'
        required: false
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0   # заметки релиза собираются из коммитов после прошлого тега

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install deps
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Python deps
        run: |
          cd backend
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Lint + tests
        run: npm run check && npm test

      - name: Build www
        run: npm run build:www

      - name: Add Android platform
        run: npx cap add android

      - name: Sync Capacitor
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Restore release keystore from secrets
        run: |
          mkdir -p keystore
          echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > keystore/voicecomic-release.jks
          {
            echo 'STORE_FILE=../keystore/voicecomic-release.jks'
            echo 'STORE_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}'
            echo 'KEY_ALIAS=${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}'
            echo 'KEY_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}'
          } > android/keystore.properties
          node tools/patch-signing.mjs

      - name: Build signed release APK
        run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.version != '')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          APK=$(ls android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk | head -1)
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
            TAG="v${VERSION}"
          else
            TAG="${{ github.ref_name }}"
            VERSION="${TAG#v}"
          fi
          mv "$APK" "voicecomic-$TAG.apk"
          # Заметки собираются из коммитов после прошлого тега: зашитый
          # текст однажды устарел и описывал уже выпущенную версию.
          PREV=$(git tag --sort=-creatordate | grep -v "^${TAG}$" | head -1 || true)
          {
            echo "Сборка в GitHub Actions, коммит \`${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}\`."
            echo
            echo "**Что нового в ${VERSION}:**"
            if [ -n "$PREV" ]; then
              git log --no-merges --pretty=format:'- %s (%h)' "$PREV"..HEAD
            else
              git log --no-merges --pretty=format:'- %s (%h)' | head -30
            fi
            echo
            echo
            echo "**APK (release-signed, versionName ${VERSION}):** voicecomic-${TAG}.apk"
            echo "Обновление ставится поверх предыдущей сборки: versionCode растёт монотонно."
          } > release-notes.md
          cat release-notes.md
          gh release create "$TAG" "voicecomic-$TAG.apk" \
            --target "${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            --title "VoiceComic ${VERSION}" \
            --notes-file release-notes.md

Let me check existing tags: `git tag`.

Now let me plan the fixes concretely.

### Fix 1 — relay: не терять tool_calls (главная причина «nullnullnull…»)
In `sseFoldChat`:
- accumulate `tool_calls` deltas by index (id, type, function.name, function.arguments concatenated).
- accumulate `usage` from the last chunk (zen sends real usage).
- If tool_calls present → return `{ content, tool_calls, finish_reason: 'tool_calls', usage }` and NO error (currently `!content.trim()` → error "модель вернула пустой ответ" even when there ARE tool calls — that's a bug: a pure tool-call turn with no text currently errors out!).

Wait, check: in my probe, content was non-empty ("Привет! Конечно, могу помочь...") so no error. But for a model that returns ONLY tool calls with empty text, the relay would return 502 "модель вернула пустой ответ" — a false failure. Must fix: if tool_calls exist, that's a valid response.

In `completionJson`:
- include `tool_calls` in the message; `content` should be `null` when there are tool calls and no text (OpenAI-compatible), or keep the text.
- pass through real usage (already supported via `usageOf(result)` — but `result.usage` was never set! So it's always fabricated). Fix: set usage in sseFoldChat from `o.usage`.

### Fix 2 — app: не показывать мусор и не отправлять пустые/битые ходы
In `js/ai.js`:
- export a `normalizeAnswer` / handle `content` as array-of-parts (some gateways) → text; and detect `tool_calls`.
- `openAICompat`: after getting `j`, detect `message.tool_calls`; if present and no text → throw a clear error? Or return a structured object? The app's `chat()` returns a string for all callers. Cleanest: `openAICompat` throws a descriptive error when the model only returns tool calls: «модель N запросила инструменты (read, bash) — чат работает без инструментов; выберите другую модель или уточните вопрос». Hmm, but that would make zen free models unusable in the chat entirely! Every non-trivial question returns tool_calls...

Wait. That's a serious UX problem: with keyless zen free models, the chat ALWAYS ends in tool_calls (the models are agentic). Currently the user sees the text part ("Давайте сначала посмотрим...") which is a *lie* (nothing happens) and then the conversation degenerates into "nullnullnull" garbage. The screenshot shows exactly that: the user asked the agent to do something, the app apparently executed some tools (write blocked), and the model degenerated.

For a *chat* app, the honest and useful behavior: when the model returns tool calls, tell the user in one clear line: «Модель хочет использовать инструменты (bash, write) — в чате они недоступны. Попробуйте переформулировать вопрос или выбрать другую модель.» That's better than garbage.

Additionally: since the text-only part is still useful info, show both: the text (if any) + a system note about the blocked tools.

And the degenerate "nullnullnull" guard: a `sanitizeModelText()` that strips runs of repeated junk (e.g. /(\bnull\b){4,}/) — a safety net for any provider.

### Fix 3 — chat: не отправлять модели ходы с пустым content
In `chat.js`: filter out history messages with empty content; make sure the current user turn has text.

### Fix 4 — CSS: подписи нижней панели не рвутся посреди слова ("Сценари/й")

### Fix 5 — vision path: `chatWithImage` uses `m.content` directly → "[object Object]"/"null" in the prompt. Use textOf.

What about the screenshot's "10 инструментов" claim vs. reality? In this repo the chat doesn't show tool count. Skip.

The screenshot shows "Сессия 846399" which looks like a *timestamp* without formatting — as if `toLocaleString` options were ignored in the Android WebView?? Actually "Сессия 846399" = maybe `'Сессия ' + (Date.now()%1000000)`. In this repo, after the first message the title is replaced with the user's text (up to 40 chars) — so titles become the user's question. The screenshot's title is the default. Not a bug in this repo's code (format differs because different build).

Hmm, one more thing in the screenshot: the model line "opencode · ling-3.0-flash-fin-free · 🔧 10 инструментов" is the newer app. Skip.

So the plan is set. Let me be careful to keep the style: Russian comments explaining *why*, tests in smoke.mjs with regression numbers, README updated if needed (README documents features; maybe mention the tool-call behavior). Let me check README for a chat/relay section to update.
